assets.name: listening-room
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website photograph for the fictional listening and sound-art festival INTERVAL; an illustrative scene, not documentation of an actual event.
Primary request: Wide 3:2 editorial architectural photograph of a quiet, intimate experimental listening room.
Scene/backdrop: A believable simple room with dark charcoal acoustic panels, one sculptural but physically plausible wood speaker on each side, and a few empty black chairs. No people.
Style/medium: Restrained documentary photography with tactile subtle film grain, natural imperfect materials, photographic depth and realistic perspective.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 ratio. Off-center asymmetry, strong negative space and architectural stillness. The speakers and seating feel intentionally placed in a small intimate listening space.
Lighting/mood: Raking daylight, quiet atmosphere, charcoal shadows with soft amber wood.
Constraints: No text, signs, typography, logos, watermark, flashy neon, science-fiction equipment, or poster design. This is a photographic image only; the website will add typography separately.

assets.name: tape-landscape
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website photograph for the fictional listening and sound-art festival INTERVAL; an illustrative still life, not documentation of an actual event.
Primary request: 3:2 macro editorial still life of an analog reel-to-reel tape deck and loose magnetic tape on a worn charcoal worktop.
Subject: A physically believable analog reel-to-reel tape deck, brushed metal and carefully cropped reels, with one loose length of magnetic tape resting on the surface. Realistic transport and reel mechanics.
Style/medium: Restrained tactile editorial photography, subtle documentary grain, not a glossy 3D render.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 ratio, deliberate close cropped composition, strong negative space, tightly controlled shallow depth of field.
Lighting/mood: Warm highlights on brushed metal and tape, deep charcoal shadows, nearly monochrome with soft amber material tones.
Constraints: No legible branding, logos, labels or text; no watermark, people, hands, imaginary mechanisms, flashy neon, science-fiction equipment, poster design or typography.

assets.name: strings-detail
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website photograph for the fictional listening and sound-art festival INTERVAL; an illustrative scene, not documentation of an actual event.
Primary request: 3:2 close cropped photograph of acoustic cello strings, bridge and amber brown wooden body, with a bow held by someone entirely outside the frame.
Subject: Physically plausible cello construction, four strings passing across a realistic wooden bridge and continuing in their correct direction. The bow enters the crop with its holder fully outside the frame. No hands or people visible.
Style/medium: Restrained tactile editorial photography with realistic wood grain, subtle documentary grain and natural optical depth.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 ratio, tight evocative crop, strong nearblack negative space around the instrument detail.
Lighting/mood: Raking sidelight on warm amber brown wood against a deep nearblack background, gentle highlights, charcoal shadows.
Constraints: No people, hands, text, logos, watermark, poster design or typography. Photographic image only, no glossy 3D aesthetic, no exaggerated or impossible strings, bridge or bow.
